description.zh: 镜像ID。取值可以由一个或多个镜像ID组成一个JSON数组。格式为`["xxx", "yyy", … "zzz"]`。支持最多50个ID，用半角逗号字符隔开。
description.en: The image IDs. The value can be a JSON array that consists of up to 50 image IDs. Format: `["xxx", "yyy", … "zzz"]`. Separate multiple image IDs with commas (,).

description.zh:
镜像类型。取值范围：

- system：系统镜像
- app：应用镜像
- custom：自定义镜像
description.en:
The type of the images. Valid values:

- system: OS images

- app: application images

- custom: custom images

description.zh: 地域ID。您可以调用[ListRegions](~~189315~~)查询轻量应用服务器的可用地域。
description.en: The region ID of the images. You can call the [ListRegions](~~189315~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

descriptions.zh: 您可以查询指定地域下一个或多个镜像信息，包括镜像的ID、镜像名称、镜像类型等。
descriptions.en: You can query details about one or more images in a specified region, including the IDs, names, and types of the images.
